audit_design.purpose: New questions authored by evaluation agent before V2 output inspection. Withheld from implementation agent until freeze. Same project team, not external independent validation. V1 TEST already observed and is regression only. No audit-based tuning allowed.

provenance.comparability: V1 regression predictions reused byte-for-byte as observations, V2 TEST is regression only. New audit baseline and V2 evaluated at frozen mode-specific thresholds. Latencies are sequential warm local observations, not an isolated benchmark; V1 historical regression latency came from the original session.
provenance.retrieval: Raw whole-query top3 retrieval, not facet-expanded response evidence. Multi-policy completeness separately checks all gold IDs cited in accepted response.
provenance.source_support: Sentence membership is a mechanical copy check, not entailment. Gold source completeness is not semantic answer accuracy.
